2
CRI. MISC. No. 447/2024
ORDERS ON PETITION FILED U/S.13(3) OF BIRTH AND 
DEATH REGISTRATION ACT, R/W. RULE 10(3) OF THE 
REGISTRATION OF BIRTH AND DEATHS RULES.
The petitioners have filed the above petition and sought for 
direction to the respondents to enter the date of death of mother 
of petitioner No.1 and wife of petitioner No.2 by name "Smt. 
Vishranti Ashok Mestri” and issue death certificate accordingly.
2.
Brief facts of the petitioner’s case are as under :
 
 
 
The mother of petitioner No.1 and wife of petitioner No.2 
Late "Smt. Vishranti Ashok Mestri”, died on 23-03-2021 at 
Koganoli village, Taluka. Nipani, leaving behind her, petitioners 
as the only legal heirs.  The date of death of Smt. Vishranti Ashok 
Mestri, was not registered with the respondents and the 
petitioners were under impression that the said date of death of 
Smt. Vishranti Ashok Mestri, was registered in the concerned 
death register through their relatives and as such, till today, the 
petitioners could not register the said date of death of Smt. 
Vishranti Ashok Mestri, in the concerned death register 
maintained by the respondent. When the petitioners approached 
the respondents for issuance of death certificate of Smt. Vishranti 
Ashok Mestri, he issued non-availability certificate. Hence, this 
petition.
3.
The notice of the petition was served on the 
respondents. Though, the notice of the petition was published 
through paper publication neither the respondents nor anybody 
appeared before the court and resisted the application.

3
CRI. MISC. No. 447/2024
4.
In order to prove the averments of the petition, 
petitioner No.1 has filed an affidavit in lieu of oral evidence and 
was examined as P.W.1 and relied upon 6 documents as per 
Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.6 and closed his evidence.  
5.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners. 
Perused the materials available on record. 
6.
The points that arise for my consideration are: 
POINTS
1.
Whether the petitioners are 
entitled for the relief claimed?
2.
What order?
7.
My findings on the above Points are:
Point No.1: In the Affirmative
Point No.2: As per final order,
      
 
   for the following:
REASONS
8.
Point No.1
 
  :-
 
In order to substantiate the averments of the petition, 
petitioner No.1 has filed an affidavit in lieu of chief examination by 
reiterating the averments of the petition and examined himself  as 
P.W.1 and relied upon 6 documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.6. 
Ex.P.1 is the non-availability certificate, Ex.P.2 is the notarized 
copy of Aadhar Card of PW.1, Ex.P3 is the notarized copy of 
Aadhar Card of petitioner No.2, Ex.P4 is the Original Bank of 
India passbook standing in the name of mother of petitioner No.1,

4
CRI. MISC. No. 447/2024
Ex.P.5 and Ex.P.6 are the News papers. On perusal of Ex.P.4 the 
name of deceased Smt. Vishranti Ashok Mestri is appearing. 
Inspite of service of notice, through paper publication, nobody has 
resisted the claim of the petitioners. On the other hand, the 
averments of the affidavit of P.W.1, of the petition, remained 
unchallenged and non-availability certificate further corroborates 
the contention of the petitioners. Hence, there is nothing to 
disbelieve the version of the petitioners. Accordingly, Point No.1 
is answered in the "Affirmative". 
9.
Point No.2
 
 : 
In the result, this court proceed to pass the following :
             ORDER
           The petition is allowed.
 
The respondents are directed to register 
the date of death of mother of petitioner No.1 
and wife of petitioner No.2 by name “Smt. 
Vishranti Ashok Mestri,” as 23.03.2021 and 
issue Death Certificate, in accordance with 
law.
Office is hereby directed after due 
verification return the original documents if 
any.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on computer and typed by him, 
corrected by me and then signed and pronounced in the Open Court on this date the 
3rd  Day of July 2025)
Sd/-  
        
                   (Smt. Ranjeeta S.K)
              
 
          Principal Civil Judge &
